name: claude-builtins
description: Claude Code's built-in slash-command prompts, taken verbatim from the CLI binary and driven from portable plugin skills: /security-review (a senior-security-engineer review of the current branch vs origin/HEAD), /init (generate a CLAUDE.md), /insights (transcript scan, verbatim facet classification, and a self-contained HTML report), /team-onboarding (co-author an ONBOARDING.md from how you actually use Claude Code), and /usage (a local, approximate analysis of your transcripts — token counts plus the binary's relative weight; the built-in's server-side utilization/cost is not reproducible).
